data.name: Sanctum Wars: Ex Infernis
data.detailed_description:
When Heaven Falls Silent, Hell Finds a Voice.

The world of Sanctum Wars is dying.

For centuries, humanity endured beneath the protection of divine light. Then, without warning, the prayers ceased to reach Heaven. The sacred resonance that once bound mankind to God fell silent, leaving the world vulnerable to ancient horrors long imprisoned beneath reality itself.

Now corruption spreads across kingdoms. Faith is fading. Civilization is collapsing. And Hell no longer waits beyond the veil.

You are Thalor, an elite knight of the Ordo Aeternum Lux, dispatched to investigate the once-prosperous city of Valensbrück, where an entire population has vanished beneath an unholy silence.

What begins as a mission to uncover the city's fate soon reveals a conspiracy that threatens not only humanity, but the very order of creation.

Every step deeper into Valensbrück brings you closer to a truth the world was never meant to uncover.

EXPLORE A FALLEN CITY

Journey through the cursed lands of Valensbrück, from abandoned villages and forgotten mines to towering cathedrals, plague-ridden districts, ruined fortresses, and ancient catacombs hidden beneath the city.

Every location tells the story of a civilization consumed by corruption, where every ruin, every corpse, and every forgotten prayer reveals another piece of the world's downfall.

MASTER TACTICAL MELEE COMBAT

Every duel is a test of discipline.

Master deliberate, weighty melee combat inspired by historical martial traditions. Learn weapon-specific movesets, chain precise attacks, manage your stamina, and exploit enemy openings in battles where reckless aggression is punished and every strike matters.

HOLD FAST TO YOUR FAITH

As Heaven grows silent, your faith becomes your greatest weapon.

Discover sacred relics, forgotten prayers, and ancient rites that strengthen your resolve while resisting the corruption spreading throughout the world. Every decision shapes both your journey and the fate of those who still endure.

FACE THE INFERNAL

Confront corrupted humans, twisted abominations, and infernal entities born from humanity's broken connection to the divine.

Each enemy presents unique behaviors, strengths, and tactical challenges that reward observation, patience, and mastery.

A CINEMATIC DARK FANTASY EXPERIENCE

Immerse yourself in a handcrafted medieval world brought to life through cinematic storytelling, richly detailed environments, atmospheric lighting, and an original orchestral soundtrack.

Every ruined chapel, abandoned battlefield, forgotten village, and whispered prayer serves a larger mystery waiting to be uncovered.

FEATURES

  • Explore the first chapter of the Sanctum Wars universe.

  • Experience a dark medieval world inspired by Gothic architecture and historical Europe.

  • Master tactical third-person melee combat built around precision, timing, and weapon mastery.

  • Uncover the mystery behind God's Silence through exploration and environmental storytelling.

  • Face terrifying infernal creatures and unforgettable boss encounters.

  • Discover sacred relics, forgotten prayers, and powerful rites.

  • Traverse handcrafted villages, mines, castles, cathedrals, and underground catacombs.

  • Experience cinematic storytelling powered by next-generation visuals and immersive audio.

data.short_description: A dark medieval action RPG where faith is fading and demons walk among men. Uncover the truth behind God's silence, master brutal tactical melee combat, and fight your way through the cursed city of Valensbrück.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent depictions of medieval combat, blood, and violence against both human and non-human enemies. Players will encounter corpses, infernal creatures, disturbing imagery, and themes of horror, corruption, death, and religious darkness. The game includes mature narrative themes involving faith, despair, and supernatural evil. It does not contain explicit sexual content or nudity.
